name: league-of-legends-new-dawn-2027
lines:
بيليزا: «سنطلق العام المقبل
مشغّلًا محدّثًا للعبة»

عرضت ريوت غيمز المقطع
في نهائي بطولة العالم
headline:
لعبة League of Legends
عهد جديد يبدأ في 2027
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Riot's official New Dawn video: League of Legends gets its big overhaul in 2027 (Lux, Ahri, Blitzcrank and the new Summoner's Rift on screen)
angle.why_now: revealed at the Worlds 2026 final, 14 Nov 2026 21:59Z (League of Legends official X post), under 18 hours before the slot; no Arabic outlet had it in the digest
angle.what_it_means_here: the most played PC game in the region changes its client, map look and gameplay next year; full reveal in January
angle.payoff: the full reveal date (January) and where it was shown

story_type_items.TRAILER OR FIRST LOOK: what the footage shows that is new: the redesigned Summoner's Rift (brush, terrain, Baron Nashor), new champion visuals; the actual Riot video, credited «المصدر: ريوت غيمز (Riot Games)» on every shot
story_type_items.INTERVIEW/QUOTE: Paul Bellezza (League executive producer per IGN 14 Nov; on-screen lower third 'PAUL BELLEZZA / PABRO' at 1 to 3 s) said at 26.0 to 30.4 s: 'next year we're releasing a modernized client' (faster-whisper word times, lips checked on frames 0.4 to 4.0 s)

reel_check.1 primary read in full: yes: League of Legends official X post 2121724627667824796 (14 Nov 2026 21:59Z, 'A peek at where we're headed for 2027', video 121.3 s, transcribed in full) and leagueoflegends.com/en-us/new-dawn/ (subscribe page, teaser embed vs3p3mNhRXo)
reel_check.1 not already posted: yes: git grep 'new dawn' over newsroom/stories finds no story; the 14 Nov LoL esports roadmap story is a different item; ledger.py find crashes on a list folder (as on FreeStyle), searched by hand
reel_check.1 older than 24h: yes: first report 14 Nov 21:59Z, slot 15 Nov 15:15Z (17 h)
reel_check.2 angle before lines: yes: angle block in this job
reel_check.4 one spoken paragraph: yes: Paul Bellezza, «we will release an updated client next year»; the Summoner's Rift map is renewed, gameplay and the champion experience evolve; full reveal in January; Riot showed it at the Worlds final
reel_check.4 subject named before pronoun, no line: yes: line 3 «وتتطور» continues line 2 with no gap (hard cut, 0 s)
reel_check.4 release verbs: yes: no date verb on screen; captions use يصدر التحديث في 2027
reel_check.4 names match names-ar: yes: ريوت غيمز (Riot Games) per names-ar row of 14 Nov; بول بيليزا added; مشغّل for client added as a term
reel_check.5 headline: yes: «لعبة League of Legends / عهد جديد يبدأ في 2027», fact and year, opens on an Arabic word
reel_check.5 lines: yes: opens on the quote; ends on where it was shown
reel_check.5 caption: yes: first five words carry تحديث and League of Legends; source named
reel_check.5 X and Threads: yes: one sentence, source «حسب المقطع الرسمي للشركة», no hashtags
reel_check.5 urgency: yes: chip رسمي (Riot's own video); not عاجل; «ولم تشرح الشركة بعد تغييرات طريقة اللعب بالتفصيل»
reel_check.6 sound: yes: the trailer's own music from 96.8 s (the finale under the gameplay montage, then the logo sting), music_only: effects stripped, no voice in the stretch (faster-whisper: last word 'ready' ends about 96.4 s, nothing after); 96.8 to 118.1 s
reel_check.6 no narration under lines: yes: the stretch has no speech at all
reel_check.7 not the same picture as last 5 Reels: yes: picture: LoL cinematic and gameplay, no LoL Reel in the last 5
reel_check.7 crop: yes: 9:16 crops checked at 4 fps with the person box and headline band drawn (Lux face left of the box, box over her hair)
reel_check.7 headline not over a face; no face behi: yes: Lux's face sits left of the box (x<450) and below the headline band; the box closes at 2.9 s before Paul's clip
reel_check.7 credit on every clip: yes: one credit 0 to 10, card span included

decision_log: 0 Lux 64.7 s (1.35): cover, the face of League; at 64.7 her eye and lips are lit (64.25 to 64.6 her face is in shadow), crop window x 735 (focus 0.42) so her face sits left of the person box, box over her hair, headline band over her hair; alternatives Blitzcrank 60 s (head fills 9:16, box over an eye), Volibear 78 s (head under the headline), sunset 44 s (dark, not recognisable)
1 swirl on the new Summoner's Rift 106.15 (1.1): box still open, no line; no faces behind the box
2 Paul Bellezza 25.75 (4.8): the speaker while his quote reads; he says exactly this sentence 25.98 to 30.4 s; silent under music_only

3 to 6 gameplay 100.12, 103.82, 109.1 (Baron Nashor redesign), 107.45: the new map look for «خريطة Summoner's Rift تتجدد»; minions 105.15 dropped (melee minions hold swords), 102.35 and 107.9 to 108.9 dropped (champions firing beams), flashes at 99.6 to 100.0 and 100.65 avoided
7 to 8 Tristana 72.75 and Ekko 76.35 (after the teal burst at 76.1): champion close-ups for «تجربة الأبطال»
9 card «الكشف الكامل / يناير» on the sunset Blitzcrank silhouette 52 s (ground_footage); the date lives only on the card
10 Ahri 89.3 to 93.8: the payoff picture under «عرضت ريوت غيمز المقطع في نهائي بطولة العالم»; last 2 s a picture, black at 94.46 avoided

sound: track 96.8 s of the same video (finale music under the gameplay montage, then the logo sting decaying into our end card), music_only: score kept, gameplay effects removed so no effect lands on a shot from another moment; music_fade 0.3/0.6; 96.8 to 118.1 s, no words (faster-whisper; the narration ends with 'So get ready' at 96.4 s). The 44 s cinematic stretch was rejected: narration at 58.6 to 70 s, and speech_ok would turn the split off
